title: 매일 하는 일 말하기: 가요, 먹어요, 해요
objective: By the end, you can choose -아요, -어요, or 해요 for a verb and use the short forms such as 가요, 와요, and 마셔요 when you talk about your day.
summary: Learn how to change a verb into the polite everyday ending -아요/어요/해요 by looking at the last vowel of the stem.

task.title: Make the 해요 form
task.line: Remove -다, check the last vowel of the stem, then add the right ending and shorten it if needed.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is ㅏ or ㅗ (e.g. 살다 → 살아요, 좋다 → 좋아요).
forms.means: Polite everyday ending. Use it for statements and, with a rising tone, for questions.

forms.when: The last vowel of the stem is anything other than ㅏ or ㅗ (e.g. 먹다 → 먹어요, 읽다 → 읽어요).
forms.means: Same polite ending, just with a different vowel.
forms.exampleMeaning: I eat bread in the morning.

forms.when: The verb ends in 하다 (e.g. 공부하다, 청소하다).
The stem ends in ㅏ or ㅓ with no final consonant (가다, 자다, 서다).
forms.means: The two vowels are the same, so only one is written.

forms.when: The stem ends in ㅗ with no final consonant (오다).
forms.means: ㅗ and 아 join into ㅘ.
forms.exampleMeaning: My friend is coming to my house.

forms.form: ㅣ + 어 → ㅕ, ㅜ + 어 → ㅝ
forms.when: The stem ends in ㅣ or ㅜ with no final consonant (마시다, 배우다 → 배워요).
forms.means: ㅣ + 어 joins into ㅕ, and ㅜ + 어 joins into ㅝ.

watchOut: 가아요 (X) → 가요 (O): ㅏ + 아 is written only once.
마시아요 (X) → 마셔요 (O): ㅣ is not ㅏ or ㅗ, so it takes 어, and ㅣ + 어 joins into ㅕ.
먹아요 (X) → 먹어요 (O): Look at the vowel (ㅓ), not the final consonant. Only ㅏ and ㅗ take -아요.
공부하아요 (X) → 공부해요 (O): Every 하다 verb becomes 해요.
exercises: Add -아요 or -어요 to the verb in brackets: ① 창문을 (열다) → ____ ② 의자에 (앉다) → ____ ③ 코트를 (입다) → ____
Write the 해요 form of the verb in brackets: ① 오늘은 회사에서 (일하다) → ____ ② 저녁에 엄마에게 (전화하다) → ____
Write the short form of the verb in brackets: ① 시장에서 과일을 (사다) → ____ ② 오후에 친구를 (만나다) → ____ ③ 동생에게 선물을 (주다) → ____
Each sentence has one wrong verb. Write the correct form: ① 저는 매일 지하철을 타아요. ② 역 앞에서 친구를 기다리아요.
Answer the question in Korean. Use the words in brackets: ① A: 주말에 뭐 해요? B: (영화를 보다) ② A: 지금 뭐 해요? B: (음식을 만들다)
answers: ① 열어요 ② 앉아요 ③ 입어요
① 사요 ② 만나요 ③ 줘요
① 영화를 봐요. (영화를 보아요. is also correct) ② 음식을 만들어요.
